mapper.select: SELECT og.id AS optionGroupId, og.name AS name, gt.code AS groupType, CASE WHEN og.max_select <= 1 THEN 'SINGLE' ELSE 'MULTIPLE' END AS selectType, og.min_select AS minSelect, og.max_select AS maxSelect, CASE WHEN og.min_select > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isRequired, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS recommendedLabel FROM opt_group og JOIN common_code gt ON gt.id = og.group_type_id ORDER BY og.id

SELECT og.id AS optionGroupId, og.name AS name, gt.code AS groupType, CASE WHEN og.max_select <= 1 THEN 'SINGLE' ELSE 'MULTIPLE' END AS selectType, og.min_select AS minSelect, og.max_select AS maxSelect, CASE WHEN og.min_select > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isRequired, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS recommendedLabel FROM opt_group og JOIN common_code gt ON gt.id = og.group_type_id WHERE og.id = #{optionGroupId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM opt_policy op WHERE op.id = #{optionGroupId} AND op.opt_group_id = og.id ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN og.id = #{optionGroupId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1

SELECT id FROM ( SELECT id, 1 AS priority FROM opt_policy WHERE id = #{optionGroupId} UNION ALL SELECT id, 2 AS priority FROM opt_policy WHERE opt_group_id = #{optionGroupId} ) candidates ORDER BY priority LIMIT 1
SELECT opt_item_id FROM opt_policy_item WHERE policy_id = #{policyId} ORDER BY opt_item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_opt_policy (menu_id, policy_id, sort_no, required) VALUES ( #{menuId}, #{policyId}, #{sortNo}, #{required} )
INSERT INTO menu_opt_override (menu_id, opt_item_id, recommended) VALUES ( #{menuId}, #{optionItemId}, #{recommended} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE recommended = VALUES(recommended)
mapper.select: SELECT oi.id AS optionItemId, oi.name AS name, oi.add_price AS extraPrice, oi.sold_out AS isSoldOut, opi.recommended AS isRecommended FROM opt_policy op JOIN opt_policy_item opi ON opi.policy_id = op.id JOIN opt_item oi ON oi.id = opi.opt_item_id WHERE op.id = ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT id, 1 AS priority FROM opt_policy WHERE id = #{optionGroupId} UNION ALL SELECT id, 2 AS priority FROM opt_policy WHERE opt_group_id = #{optionGroupId} ) candidates ORDER BY priority LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY opi.sort_no, oi.id

SELECT oi.id AS optionItemId, oi.name AS name, oi.add_price AS extraPrice, oi.sold_out AS isSoldOut, COALESCE(moo.recommended, opi.recommended) AS isRecommended FROM menu_opt_policy mop JOIN opt_policy op ON op.id = mop.policy_id JOIN opt_policy_item opi ON opi.policy_id = op.id JOIN opt_item oi ON oi.id = opi.opt_item_id LEFT JOIN menu_opt_override moo ON moo.menu_id = mop.menu_id AND moo.opt_item_id = oi.id WHERE mop.menu_id = #{menuId} AND ( op.opt_group_id = #{optionGroupId} OR op.id = #{optionGroupId} ) ORDER BY opi.sort_no, oi.id
